title: Introducing upgrades to Codex
summary: Codex just got faster, more reliable, and better at real-time collaboration and tackling tasks independently anywhere you develop—whether via the terminal, IDE, web, or even your phone.
body: Codex just got faster, more reliable, and better at real-time collaboration and tackling tasks independently anywhere you develop—whether via the terminal, IDE, web, or even your phone.
summaryZh: OpenAI对Codex进行了性能升级，提升了其响应速度与可靠性。此次更新增强了模型在终端、IDE及移动端等多种开发环境下的实时协作能力，支持开发者更独立地完成复杂编程任务。原始信息显示：Codex just got faster, more reliable, and better at real-time collaboration and tackling tasks independently anywhere you develop—whether via the terminal, IDE, web, or even your phone.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Introducing upgrades to Codex”。其重要性主要体现在：Codex的性能升级直接影响开发者的编程效率与AI辅助编码工具的实用性。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
